name: mordred-fated-luminary-attack-card-played-from-hand-goes-to-graveyard
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): only attack cards played via EPHEMERATE (from the graveyard) become ephemeral. Guard for the ephemeral-intent tagging added with the Ephemerate fix: a Striking Tides played for real from the HAND (printed reserve cost 3 paid, player 2's champion hit for 4) goes to the graveyard after combat, it is not banished.

rulesClauses: Only attack cards played via Ephemerate are ephemeral: an attack card played normally from hand returns to the graveyard.
